fact: MTN Bénin's own product page offers businesses rental of servers and storage at its MTN Data Center, with redundant SBEE, generator and UPS power; the page is undated and the date is its capture date.
MTN Bénin launched its data centre service for start-ups and firms of all sizes on 14 June 2019, offering outsourced hosting, off-site backup and disaster recovery.

Isocel Telecom states it launched Benin's first neutral data centre, made available to large-account customers in 2015 (article of July 2015), with hosting offers and neutral interconnection to Benin IX.

An ASIN official says Benin has several data centres, including one operated commercially by the Société béninoise des infrastructures numériques (SBIN); the article gives no opening date and is dated 2026-04-14.

ST DIGITAL, a pan-African data-centre operator, says it has infrastructure and sites deployed in Bénin among seven countries serving banks, telecoms operators, administrations and enterprises; the post is dated 2026-03-03 and gives no opening date.
Data centres dataset: Isocel Telecom Datacenter (Isocel Telecom), colocation/carrier-neutral, in service; this document names it (published 2025-10-27).
